{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history includes negative values (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00 with recent declines), indicating bearish momentum.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if model shows significant overshoots (e.g., >10% above true outcome) following recent spikes.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is consistently above true outcome over 3-5 days, reduce by 2-5% per day to align with historical mean.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment history shows no recent positive signals (e.g., all 0.00), suggesting lack of bullish momentum.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term volatility: if true outcome shows sharp drops after spikes, reduce forecast peak by 15-20% to prevent overcorrection.",
    "If sentiment history includes 0.50 or higher, slightly increase forecast to reflect bullish sentiment, but cap at 10% above recent mean.",
    "For horizon > 15 days, apply smoothing: reduce forecast volatility by 10-15% to avoid overfitting to recent noise."
  ]
}
